title: 第28课 · 今天比昨天冷
subtitle: Lesson 28 — 今天比昨天冷 · It is colder today than it was yesterday

items.en: It's colder today than it was yesterday.

items.py: Zhèr bǐ Dōngjīng lěng duō le.
items.en: It's much colder here than in Tokyo.

items.zh: 天气预报说，明天有大风。
items.py: Tiānqì yùbào shuō, míngtiān yǒu dà fēng.
items.en: The weather forecast says there will be strong winds tomorrow.

items.py: Míngtiān bǐ jīntiān hái lěng ne.
items.en: Tomorrow will be even colder than today.
You should put on more clothes.

items.zh: 那儿的天气跟这儿一样吗？
items.py: Nàr de tiānqì gēn zhèr yīyàng ma?
items.en: Is the weather there the same as here?

items.py: Qìwēn zài líng xià èrshí duō dù.
items.en: The temperature is over 20 degrees below zero.

items.py: Liú Jīng: Jīntiān tiānqì zhēn lěng.
items.en: Liu Jing: The weather is really cold today.

items.zh: 和子：是啊。今天比昨天冷。
items.py: Hézǐ: Shì a. Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng.
items.en: Hezi: Yes. It's colder today than yesterday.

items.py: Wēndù bǐ zuótiān dī wǔ dù.
items.en: The temperature is 5 degrees lower than yesterday.

items.zh: 刘京：这儿的天气你习惯了吗？
items.py: Liú Jīng: Zhèr de tiānqì nǐ xíguàn le ma?
items.en: Liu Jing: Have you gotten used to the weather here?

items.zh: 和子：还不太习惯呢。这儿比东京冷多了。
items.py: Hézǐ: Hái bú tài xíguàn ne. Zhèr bǐ Dōngjīng lěng duō le.
items.en: Hezi: Not quite yet. It's much colder here than Tokyo.

items.zh: 刘京：你们那儿冬天不太冷吧？
items.py: Liú Jīng: Nǐmen nàr dōngtiān bú tài lěng ba?
items.en: Liu Jing: It's not too cold in winter where you are, right?

items.py: Liú Jīng: Dōngjīng cháng xià xuě ma?
items.en: Liu Jing: Does it often snow in Tokyo?

items.zh: 和子：很少下雪。有时候下雨。
items.py: Hézǐ: Hěn shǎo xià xuě. Yǒushíhou xià yǔ.
items.en: Hezi: It rarely snows. Sometimes it rains.

items.zh: 刘京：天气预报说，明天有大风，比今天还冷呢。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Tiānqì yùbào shuō, míngtiān yǒu dà fēng, bǐ jīntiān hái lěng ne.
items.en: Liu Jing: The forecast says strong winds tomorrow, even colder than today.

items.zh: 刘京：你要多穿衣服，别感冒了。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Nǐ yào duō chuān yīfu, bié gǎnmào le.
items.en: Liu Jing: Dress warmly, don't catch a cold.

items.zh: 玛丽：张老师，北京的夏天热吗？
items.py: Mǎlì: Zhāng lǎoshī, Běijīng de xiàtiān rè ma?
items.en: Mary: Teacher Zhang, is it hot in Beijing in summer?

items.zh: 张老师：很热。你们那儿跟这儿一样吗？
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Hěn rè. Nǐmen nàr gēn zhèr yīyàng ma?
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Very hot. Is it the same where you are?

items.zh: 玛丽：不一样，夏天不热，冬天很冷。
items.py: Mǎlì: Bù yīyàng, xiàtiān bú rè, dōngtiān hěn lěng.
items.en: Mary: Not the same — summer isn't hot, winter is very cold.

items.py: Mǎlì: Líng xià èrshí duō dù.
Mǎlì: Kěyǐ huá bīng, huá xuě.
items.en: Mary: You can ice skate and ski.
What will the weather be like tomorrow?

items.zh: 天气预报说明天会下雨吗？
items.py: Tiānqì yùbào shuō míngtiān huì xià yǔ ma?
items.en: Does the forecast say it will rain tomorrow?

items.zh: 天气预报说明天会下小雨。
items.py: Tiānqì yùbào shuō míngtiān huì xià xiǎo yǔ.
items.en: The forecast says there will be light rain tomorrow.

items.py: Míngtiān huì guā dà fēng ma?
items.en: Will there be strong winds tomorrow?

items.zh: 今天下雨吗？今天不下雨。
items.py: Jīntiān xià yǔ ma? Jīntiān bú xià yǔ.
items.en: Is it raining today? It's not raining today.

items.zh: 去年冬天荷兰下雪了吗？
items.py: Qùnián dōngtiān Hélán xià xuě le ma?
items.en: Did it snow in the Netherlands last winter?

items.py: Xià dà xuě háishi xià xiǎo xuě?

items.zh: 冬天常常零下还是零上？
items.py: Dōngtiān chángcháng líng xià háishi líng shàng?
items.en: Is it usually below or above zero in winter?
This year's winter hasn't come yet.
He is older than me. (A 比 B + adj)
He is a little older than me. (slight difference)

items.py: Nàr bǐ zhèr lěng duō le.
items.en: It's much colder there than here. (big difference)

items.zh: 他跳舞跳得比我好得多。
items.py: Tā tiàowǔ tiào de bǐ wǒ hǎo de duō.
items.en: He dances much better than me.

items.zh: 今天的温度比昨天低五度。
items.py: Jīntiān de wēndù bǐ zuótiān dī wǔ dù.
items.en: Today's temperature is 5 degrees lower than yesterday's. (quantity complement)

items.py: Tā bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì.
items.en: He is two years older than me.

items.py: Tā jiā bǐ wǒ jiā duō liǎng kǒu rén.
items.en: His family has two more people than mine.
WRONG: Cannot use 很/非常/太 with 比!

items.py: Qiézi bǐ xīlánhuā guì duō le. ✓
items.en: CORRECT: Eggplant is much more expensive than broccoli.

data.topic: 语法笔记 · Grammar Notes (下/刮 + Nouns)

items.py: Yǔ shì míngcí, xuě shì míngcí.
items.en: Rain is a noun, snow is a noun.

items.zh: 下雨 = 动词 + 名词
下雪 = 动词 + 名词
刮风 = 动词 + 名词

items.py: Zhè běn shū bǐ nà běn shū hǎo.
items.en: This book is better than that book.

items.py: Zhèr bǐ Dōngjīng lěng duō le.
items.en: It's much colder here than in Tokyo.

items.zh: 这个练习比那个练习难多了。
items.py: Zhège liànxí bǐ nàge liànxí nán duō le.
items.en: This exercise is much harder than that one.

items.py: Míngtiān bǐ jīntiān hái lěng ne.
items.en: Tomorrow will be even colder than today.

items.zh: 那儿的东西比这儿还贵呢。
items.py: Nàr de dōngxi bǐ zhèr hái guì ne.
items.en: Things there are even more expensive than here.

items.zh: 那个孩子比这个还胖呢。
items.py: Nàge háizi bǐ zhège hái pàng ne.
items.en: That kid is even fatter than this one.
You're welcome to come to Beijing in autumn.

items.zh: 那时候天气最好，不冷也不热。
items.py: Nà shíhou tiānqì zuì hǎo, bù lěng yě bú rè.
items.en: The weather is best then — not cold and not hot.

items.zh: 北京的春天常常刮风，不常下雨。
items.py: Běijīng de chūntiān chángcháng guā fēng, bù cháng xià yǔ.
items.en: In Beijing spring, it often blows but doesn't often rain.

items.zh: 今年冬天不冷也不暖和。
items.py: Jīnnián dōngtiān bù lěng yě bù nuǎnhuo.
items.en: This winter is neither cold nor warm.

items.zh: 我二十四岁，他二十岁。→ 我比他大四岁。
items.py: Wǒ èrshísì suì, tā èrshí suì. → Wǒ bǐ tā dà sì suì.
items.en: I'm 24, he's 20. → I'm four years older than him.

items.zh: 昨天气温二十七度，今天二十五度。→ 今天比昨天低两度。
items.py: Zuótiān qìwēn èrshíqī dù, jīntiān èrshíwǔ dù. → Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān dī liǎng dù.
items.en: Yesterday 27°, today 25°. → Today is 2 degrees lower than yesterday.

items.zh: 他的毛衣很好看，我的毛衣不好看。→ 他的毛衣比我的好看。
items.py: Tā de máoyī hěn hǎokàn, wǒ de máoyī bù hǎokàn. → Tā de máoyī bǐ wǒ de hǎokàn.
items.en: His sweater is nice, mine isn't. → His sweater looks better than mine.

items.zh: 小王常常感冒，小刘很少有病。→ 小刘比小王健康。
items.py: Xiǎo Wáng chángcháng gǎnmào, Xiǎo Liú hěn shǎo yǒu bìng. → Xiǎo Liú bǐ Xiǎo Wáng jiànkāng.
items.en: Xiao Wang often catches colds, Xiao Liu rarely gets sick. → Xiao Liu is healthier than Xiao Wang.

items.zh: 他的词典比我的词典新。
items.py: Tā de cídiǎn bǐ wǒ de cídiǎn xīn.
items.en: His dictionary is newer than mine.

items.zh: 今天气温比昨天高四度。
items.py: Jīntiān qìwēn bǐ zuótiān gāo sì dù.
items.en: Today's temperature is 4 degrees higher than yesterday's.

items.zh: 小王家比小张家少两口人。
items.py: Xiǎo Wáng jiā bǐ Xiǎo Zhāng jiā shǎo liǎng kǒu rén.
items.en: Xiao Wang's family has two fewer people than Xiao Zhang's.

items.zh: 小李滑冰比小张滑得好多了。
items.py: Xiǎo Lǐ huá bīng bǐ Xiǎo Zhāng huá de hǎo duō le.
items.en: Xiao Li skates much better than Xiao Zhang.

items.zh: 我做菜比我的老公做的好多了。
items.py: Wǒ zuò cài bǐ wǒ de lǎogōng zuò de hǎo duō le.
items.en: I cook much better than my husband.
Today's temperature is higher than yesterday's.

items.zh: 今天比昨天气温高多少度？
items.py: Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān qìwēn gāo duōshao dù?
items.en: How many degrees higher is it today than yesterday?

items.zh: 今天的气温比昨天的气温高一点。
items.py: Jīntiān de qìwēn bǐ zuótiān de qìwēn gāo yīdiǎn.
items.en: Today's temperature is a little higher than yesterday's.

items.zh: 今天的气温比昨天的气温高多了。
items.py: Jīntiān de qìwēn bǐ zuótiān de qìwēn gāo duō le.
items.en: Today's temperature is much higher than yesterday's.

items.py: Qiézi bǐ xīlánhuā guì duō le.
items.en: Eggplant is much more expensive than broccoli.

items.py: Tā de máoyī bǐ wǒ de hǎokàn.
items.en: His sweater looks better than mine.
a little over 2 years old (多 = not yet 1 more)
